proposal.rationale: Round 1 set binary_threshold=110, hough_threshold_oblique=32, and maxLineGap_oblique=40. That moved correspondence by only 0.005 and did not extend lines left of x about 835. Left-ring gray pixels have median intensity about 106, so 110 still drops about half of them, and a gap of 40 does not bridge the fragmented clusters. Lower the binary threshold to 100, the oblique accumulator to 24, and raise maxLineGap_oblique to 56 so those clusters can form lines. Raise pattern_tolerance to 16 so new intersections can match the K/AB spacing instead of staying on the flat propagated row. Keep uniform_k_snap false, leave vertical Hough and the horizontal threshold at the round-1 incumbent, and do not touch unfolding, denoising, enhancing, or SAM: fill and depth holes are not the failing measurements, and ring count is already exact.
